summary: Bind authenticated gateway attempts to durable business cost observations

delivery.outcome: PLF-22330 / PLF-22321 slice2: bind authenticated gateway requests to trusted server-registered business case references, persist every actual provider attempt through the merged durable cost journal, and preserve paid results when observation delivery fails.
nonGoals: No production activation, routing/model priority change, prices, implicit FX or provider request replay.
Do not change active primary resolver.py, managed standard files, existing lease projections or global CI policy.
No business goal success claim; dedicated cost stream joins execution evidence in PLF-22322.

architecture.decision: Reuse the merged GatewayCostObserver and current actual-attempt seam. Authenticate an opaque server-granted case reference before admission; ContextVar carries that binding within the existing worker thread. Unknown fees and pending observation state stay in the journal; exceptions in new telemetry cannot cause another paid attempt.
interfaceChanges: Optional authenticated business-case reference and cost-observation HTTP response headers
architecture.rollback: Revert bounded source integration via protected publication; preserve journal and active user work.

validation.evidence: Actual gateway transport seam, auth/grants, failover, durable cost and failure-injection tests.
